aboutPreview.title: Understanding yourself. Building healthier relationships.
paragraphs: I am a psychotherapist, counsellor and coach. I work with people who are carrying more than they let on: anxiety, grief, emotional exhaustion, relationship difficulties or a sense of having lost touch with who they are.

Many of the people I work with are managing. They go to work, care for their families and meet their responsibilities. From the outside, everything may look fine. But beneath the surface, they may be struggling with emotions they do not understand, experiences they have not processed or problems they have been carrying alone.
aboutPreview.quote: You do not have to wait until everything falls apart before seeking support.
aboutPreview.credentialLine: PhD in Psychology · Founder and Lead Therapist, Activator Coaching Academy

services.title: Choose where to start.
services.intro: Every person and relationship is different. Explore the services below to find the support that best fits your circumstances.

assessments.title: Two free reflective tools
assessments.intro: There are no perfect answers. The purpose is awareness, not judgement. Both are reflective tools, not a clinical diagnosis or a validated psychological test.

cards.title: The Relationship Self-Audit
cards.body: Reflect on five areas that can influence relationship health: self-knowledge, emotional regulation, inherited patterns, capacity and readiness, and conflict and repair.

cards.title: The Relational Risk Assessment
cards.body: A reflective check-in on the health of your relationship, across five areas that influence its health and stability.

beliefs.title: Four things I will say out loud.

process.title: Four steps, with room to decide.
process.intro: Beginning therapy does not mean committing to an indefinite process. You can ask questions, review your progress and decide whether to continue.

closing.intro: You do not need to have everything figured out before seeking support. Whether you are working through a difficult experience, trying to understand yourself or hoping to build a healthier relationship, we can begin where you are.
